name: Helpful handoff in the customer's language
description: When the agent cannot do something (order, book, pay, confirm), it gives the concrete next step that the site states.
criteria: When the agent cannot complete the request, it gives the concrete next step stated on the site, such as the phone number or the visiting hours.
The next step is in plain words a non-technical customer can act on.
The agent answers in the language the customer wrote in.
